items.t: Said he is passionate about making sure government does not eliminate the rights of parents to raise their children as they see fit.
items.q: I am very passionate about making sure that we don’t produce a government so powerful that it eliminates the rights of us as parents to raise our children how we see fit.

items.t: Said it is not the government's job to tell him what marriage is or how it is supposed to look.
items.q: It’s not the Governments job to tell me what marriage is, or how it’s supposed to look.

items.t: Said the nation needs to see a reversal in the importance of the family unit, and that a strong family makes a strong nation.
items.q: I know that we as a nation need to see a reversal in the importance of the family unit. When the family is strong, the nation is strong.
